$comment: Which routes in src/app.tsx the layout audits visit. `samples`: a URL for a route with parameters (routes with their own readiness code are in harness/bench/probes/layout.ts › LAYOUT_PAGES). `skip`: a route that gets no audit, and why. Not part of the evaluator: a new route and its line here land in the same PR. Every key must be a route in src/app.tsx, or `check` fails.

skip./admin: admins only; the lab has no session
skip./playlists/:playlistId: a playlist lives in the browser's storage, and a fresh lab context has none
